You know those times when you feel a little smug about having your emergency kit ready? 😌 We’ve all been there, and it’s a pretty satisfying moment when you realize you’re ahead of the game. Having a well-stocked kit is like having a trusty umbrella on a cloudy day – you hope you won’t need it, but it feels good knowing it’s there. 

We just came across a great resource that outlines what to include in your kit, and it’s super user-friendly. It’s always worth taking a moment to check in on your supplies, so why not give it a look?
